transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called us together because we have a graduating student whose transcript shows an NR grade for BIO-221, and it's blocking their degree audit. As Registrar, I have the authority to finalize the transcript correction and release the degree audit for review, but per our normal records-review procedure, I need the department chair and the financial aid officer to report any relevant academic-record consequences before I can finalize the correction. This student is being processed for the Spring 2026 commencement cycle, so we need to resolve this promptly. Could I ask the department chair to start by letting us know the status of BIO-221 and what the correct grade should be?

transcript.text: I've reviewed the signed Spring 2026 grade roster for BIO-221, and I can confirm that the student earned a B+ in BIO-221, section 03. The roster was filed in the department office but has not yet been entered into the registrar's correction queue. That's likely why the NR grade is still showing on the transcript.
